pages.text: The long-lost connection between Nightfuries and Sandwraiths. They are quite rare to find, but they can be found around oceans. Their blasts are not the normal plasma of fury species; instead, it's molten glass. They fish in the waters and blend in to more easily catch their prey.$(l)$(br2)Biomes:$()$(br)All Oceans$(br)Beach$(br2)$(l)Size$()$(br)Length: 8 Blocks $(br)Wingspan: 13 Blocks
